title: Missin' Link Outdoors

services.name: Bow Fishing
services.desc: What to bring: SC Fishing License, sunglasses, sunscreen, bug repellant, drinks, snacks, food, rain gear for offshore trips for unpredictable weather or rough seas, motion sickness meds, hats, sun visor, soft-soled water shoes or tennis shoes and an empty cooler with ice for your catch. Whether you want to go fishing on Lake Murray or below it on the Tail Race Saluda River, or you would prefer Gulf Stream Trolling or Bottom Fishing, we will provide some of the greatest action and adventure you’ve ever experienced.
